svg.aria-label: HPX-DIAG-002 — Execution containers and deployment boundary
svg.desc: Which units execute, and what is absent from the release runtime? Scope: Local unless explicitly F / G. No inferred mechanism; F nodes are future contracts, G nodes are gated code.
svg.title: HPX-DIAG-002 — Execution containers and deployment boundary
